policy.inference: Ranked diagnostic evidence, not permission to mutate code, Figma, fixtures, references, or baselines.
policy.mutation: Prefer the highest shared owner that explains compatible regions; verify its complete impact matrix.

hypotheses.reason: A broad but sparse region is consistent with displaced edges, padding, size, or alignment.
Several separated regions repeat in one state; check repeated component instances before page-specific CSS.

statusContract.matched: checked with zero perceptual mismatch inside bounds
statusContract.minor-drift: checked with up to 3% perceptual mismatch inside bounds
statusContract.drift: checked with more than 3% perceptual mismatch inside bounds
statusContract.unresolved: bounds unavailable or outside the captured viewport

checks: The predicted region must improve in the fresh diagnosis.
The full-state ratio must not worsen.
Every witness target must move consistently with the causal claim.
experiment.decision: Resolve the dominant region owner before mutation; graph membership or ownership of a secondary region is insufficient.
